---
title: "Observable fixture"
format: html
---

```{ojs}
//| label: fig-controls
viewof threshold = Inputs.range([0, 10], {value: 5})
```

```{ojs}
data = [{value: 2}, {value: 8}]
```

```{ojs}
filtered = {
  const minimum = threshold;
  return data.filter(d => d.value >= minimum);
}
```

```{ojs}
mutable count = 0
```

```{ojs}
mutable count += 1
```

```{ojs}
asyncData = await Promise.resolve(filtered)
```

```{ojs}
sequence = yield* [1, 2, 3]
```

```{ojs}
import {chart as remoteChart} from "@d3/bar-chart"
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({marks: [Plot.dot(filtered, {x: "value"})]})
```
